label: The next-state truth table
subgoals: Count the state bits and the input bits
Raise two to their sum for the rows
Mark rows of unused codes as don't-cares

label: Deriving a next-state bit
subgoals: Write the next state code for every state and input row
Read the chosen next-state bit in each row
Collect the rows where it is one as minterms

label: One-hot next-state equations
subgoals: List the arcs entering the target state
Write one product of predecessor bit and arc condition per source state
